name: financial_movement_integrity
preconditionSql: SELECT to_regclass('public.financial_movements') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.treasury_balance_positions') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.posting_batches') IS NOT NULL AS ok;
verificationSql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid='public.financial_movements'::regclass AND tgname IN ('bt_financial_movements__posting_context','bt_financial_movements__immutable') AND NOT tgisinternal)=2 AS ok;
recovery: Transactional failure rolls back the Financial Movement integrity functions and triggers. After success use a forward-only migration for changes.
